statement: The T0 targetedTests check failed because run-tests.sh runs `grep -q correct src/impl.txt`, but src/impl.txt currently contains the literal text 'wrong' instead of 'correct'. This is a simple content/fixture mismatch unrelated to the auth-system ACs themselves; the gate is failing on a scaffold sentinel file, not on actual golden-fixture auth logic (which hasn't been implemented/wired yet in this bundle).
